In one line: it turns “remembering” into a retrieval contract — the source is stored upstream and never edited, the index and sandbox are rebuildable projections, and the server owns recall while precision and citation go back to the frontier model that asked. Source material: the author’s long post, plus the open skill repository (the engine is not open source; the skills are, MIT, 13 of them).

item.title: Automatic Ontology Engineering: Reading NVIDIA's Auto-Ontology at the Source
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: Auto-Ontology automates the most expensive month of ontology engineering — it reads your metadata and query history, compiles a business ontology, and hands it to agents through nine read-only tools. What it hands over is a draft: in this codebase, certification is a badge rendered for display, not a gate on the query path.

item.title: A Decentralized, Trusted MCP Runtime: Architecture and Implementation
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: treat a tool as a content-addressed artifact, run it inside a sandbox, and keep an identity behind it — only then does “trusted” mean anything. That is the architecture; the second half of this article is the implementation. 1. The problem: an agent’s tools are black boxes# An agent’s capability is not bounded by its model.
